text:
kai: FYI, noticed a surprising rise in billed token-units for some tenants after we flipped the preflight sampling to 2.5% last night. heatmap shows cluster at ~01:05 UTC.
dina: Which metric spiked? raw tokens or our internal "est_units"?
kai: internal est_units (console cost preview) vs actual routable tokens diverged. looks like estimator wasn't in the loop for ingress routing so clients still hit splitter.
owen: ah — cost preview in console is computed using the estimator, but ingress routing ignores estimator unless client calls preflight. that mismatch will confuse customers.
pm-nora: product wants two things: (1) console preview must match actual routing decisions; (2) visible changelog/billing note when sampling or estimator flags change.
dina: We should either have ingress consult estimator automatically during request admission OR mark the console preview with "may differ from actual routing" which is bad UX. Prefer automatic consult.
kai: Automatic consult means an extra cheap call at ingress. worried about adding latency and changing traffic patterns if estimator uses heavy heuristics. estimator must be O(1) and cached for small repeated payloads.
owen: implementation idea: ingress calls /v1/embeddings/preflight/estimate with a light payload (num_inputs, avg_bytes, dims_hint). estimator returns est_units, prob_split, recommended_action. ingress uses prob_split threshold to choose fastpath vs splitter. add a small LRU cache keyed by payload hash to avoid repeated calls.
ops-bot: note: adding estimator calls to ingress increases request fanout; we should measure and limit calls per second per instance. create rate cap if necessary.
dina: Console UX: show a green "matches routing" badge when estimator used in admission and cost preview is authoritative. show a red "preview != routing" when estimator was not consulted. PM wants this to reduce CS tickets.
pm-nora: also want a billing banner when sampling or estimator config changes that links to runbook and who to contact. easy for Finance.
kai: telemetry: persist estimator_decision_id and route_choice on sampled requests so we can measure estimator accuracy and preview fidelity. sampling at 1% should be enough. storage impact estimate?
dina: rough calc: 1% sampling of predictions adds ~8% to telemetry store. we'll file an observability ticket but can POC first.
owen: routing policy nuance: some enterprise tenants prefer latency over cost — allow per-tenant header X-Force-Fastpath to bypass estimator and force low-latency route. console should show a warning in that case explaining potential cost multiplier.
ops-bot: created feature-flag job f-4421 to gate "ingress-auto-estimator" in canary.
kai: rollout plan: canary in us-west for 20k requests; measure estimator latency p95 target <5ms and estimator_precision > 0.9 on detecting splits. also compare console_preview vs actual billed units; aim for <5% divergence.
dina: automation: add guardrail to rollback sampling change if splitter_amplification > 2.0 within 90m. we've done similar alerts before; ops-bot please add one specific to this flag.
ops-bot: alert rule created: embed.splitter_amplification > 2.0 within 90m of telemetry.preflight.sample_rate change (id: G-5566).
pm-nora: product ask: can console cost preview show a "recommended fix" (e.g., reduce batch size, provide dims_hint) when estimator predicts high prob_split? that would help customers self-service.
owen: can include a small text in the preview: "Estimator recommends splitting into X chunks" or "Try dims_hint: [512]". DevEx can wire copy.
kai: security/ops note: estimator endpoint must respect tenant scoping and not leak cross-tenant sampling. use signed headers and audit logs.
dina: follow-ups: DINA -> obs ticket + storage calc; OWEN -> ingress cache impl + LRU; KAI -> canary config + perf dashboard; PM-NORA -> console mock + billing banner content. ops-bot -> monitor G-5566 during rollout.
pm-nora: timeline: aim for canary nextTuesday, console follow-up mid-sprint. will prepare CS/Finance note template now.
kai: I'll start a tiny PR for ingress-estimator hook and include the LRU cache and opt-out header. tagging reviewers.
ops-bot: canary scheduled (job id: C-9009). will post summary after 1h.
